lesson.title: 7.3 Clothing
lesson.unit_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
lesson.unit_outcome: Name the body, feelings, clothes and the weather, say what you need and like, invite with Do you want to ...? and Let's, and ask for help when you do not understand.
lesson.lesson_title: Unit 7: Everyday Needs and A1 Integration
lesson.goal: Recognize and name eight clothes, and say what color they are.
lesson.grammar_function: The jacket is blue. The shoes are black. This is a skirt. These are pants.
lesson.prerequisite: 2.8 colors; 2.3 this; 2.10 these; 1.3 is and are.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Name clothes and say their color.
